agent_explanation: Single body starts 0.1m from left boundary moving left at ~11.9 m/s, so it hits the wall within step 1 (6 substeps). With e=1 an elastic bounce should preserve speed, but outgoing speed is ~13.69 m/s, larger than incoming ~11.90 m/s, raising total energy from ~147.34 J to ~170.18 J with zero controller work. This indicates the boundary-wall impulse plus positional correction injects energy on impact (e.g. penetration correction added to velocity or restitution applied on already-separated position), exceeding the 10%+5J tolerance. Setting e=0 removes the gain.
